description: Runs the Laya decision model locally to answer typed choice, score, and yes/no questions.
config.title: Laya Decision Model
config.enabled: Controls whether the local Laya decision model can be used by VS Code and extensions. The model is only loaded when a decision is requested.
config.modelPath: Path to a folder containing an exported Laya ONNX bundle (`laya.onnx`, `laya.onnx.data`, `laya_config.json` and `tokenizer/`). When empty, the default model is downloaded and verified on first use.
config.maxThreads: Maximum number of CPU threads the model may use for a single decision. Use `0` to pick a value based on the number of available cores.
config.idleUnloadMinutes: Number of minutes without requests after which the model is unloaded to free memory. Use `0` to keep the model loaded.
